_readme: Electrical steel grades offered. Edit the text values freely; keep the keys. Shown on the home page, /materials and each product page.

materials.name: Cold-Rolled Grain-Oriented electrical steel
materials.grades: 70 to 120 grade, depending on specification and availability
materials.summary: Directional magnetic properties, which is why it is used for transformer cores.
materials.detail: The grains are aligned with the rolling direction, so the steel carries magnetic flux best along its length. Transformer cores are built so the flux runs with the grain, and the 45° mitre corner keeps it close to the grain as it turns from limb to yoke.

materials.name: Cold-Rolled Non-Oriented electrical steel
materials.summary: Properties are less direction-dependent, and it is used in other electrical applications.
materials.detail: Without a strongly preferred grain direction, its magnetic properties vary much less with direction across the sheet. That suits parts where the flux does not follow one fixed path.
